context: Seed allowlist for the Track-1 dependency gate. The 2026-10-27 snapshot measured 12 CVEs on the pinned 0.x langgraph family; the current lock resolves the langgraph 1.x family and the recorded scan (docs/pip_audit_release.json) reports zero open vulnerabilities, so the seed list starts EMPTY by design. Every future entry MUST carry an explicit id/package/reason/added and follow an approved risk decision (roadmap Definition of Done). 2026-11-01: the locked set was re-audited against PyPI advisories (245 packages) — 55 vulns in 11 packages were CLOSED by locked-dep upgrades (aiohttp 3.14.5, certifi 2026.10.23, filelock 4.2.6, langgraph-sdk 0.4.11, multidict 7.x, oauthlib 4.0.1, opentelemetry 1.45.2, pyasn1 0.6.5, pypdf 6.21.4, setuptools 84.2.1, urllib3 2.8.0); only chromadb remains with no upstream fix and is documented below.
